verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only one-off scheduled vendor payments in Bill Pay ('schedule payments') and automated bank-reconciliation workflows. Neither is a documented capability to set up recurring jobs or workflows on a schedule. 'Invoice Profiles' appears only as an API index entry, with no description showing it creates recurring schedules. A one-off scheduled action is not a recurring schedule, so the documented capability for this story is absent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
